heading: What `regex: false` does not affect
text:
## What `regex: false` does not affect [LNRE.6]

- Every other string operation — interpolation, ordering — is unaffected; `regex: false` reaches only regex
  literals ([LREG.5]) and their evaluation.
- A runtime built **with** an RE2-class engine loads a `regex: false` DSC
  normally; the capability constrains what the author may write, not
  what such a runtime accepts.
- Every other registered capability ([LCAP.1]) combines with
  `regex: false` freely ([LNRE.2.2]).
